descriptionChirho: Functions as an adversative particle introducing a contrast or concession, translatable as 'however', 'nevertheless', or 'yet'. The multilingual evidence clusters tightly: eng 'however/nevertheless', spa 'sin embargo', hin फिर-भी/परन्तु, arb لكن, kor 그러나, swa 'hata hivyo'. S72147 (5x) and S72149 (1x) share near-identical adversative glosses across all six languages, differing only in frequency. Marks a logical counter-expectation in discourse.

Functions as an emphatic or affirmative particle reinforcing the truth of a statement, translatable as 'indeed', 'truly', or 'certainly'. Distinguished from the adversative sense by its confirmatory rather than contrastive force. Multilingual evidence: eng 'indeed', spa 'ciertamente', hin सचमुच, arb حقًّا ('truly'), kor 참으로 ('truly'), swa 'kweli' ('truth/truly'). The affirmative translations -- especially arb حقًّا, kor 참으로, swa kweli -- clearly separate this from the adversative 'however' cluster.
